answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: treat each identity as a vertex; pay only vertices with 12 distinct counterparties over a 30-epoch horizon. Real agents trade widely, gathering 12 edges fast. A sybil farm fails: its 1,000 vertices point at few wallets, exposing a star cluster. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 partners at 60 credits each, far above any reward. Honest agents pay once, keep their opal badge, share a pool sybils cannot dilute.
